## R Markdown


```{r}

library(ggplot2)

# === 1. Load Data ===
data_raw <- read.table("interexp.dat", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(data_raw) <- c("stimA", "stimB")

data <- data.frame(
  stimA = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9\\.]", "", data_raw$stimA)),
  stimB = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9\\.]", "", data_raw$stimB))
)

data <- data[!(is.na(data$stimA) & is.na(data$stimB)), ]

YA <- data$stimA
YB <- data$stimB



N <- nrow(data)
```




```{r}
# === 2. Initialization ===
muA <- mean(YA, na.rm = TRUE)
muB <- mean(YB, na.rm = TRUE)
sigmaA2 <- var(YA, na.rm = TRUE)
sigmaB2 <- var(YB, na.rm = TRUE)
rho <- cor(YA, YB, use = "complete.obs")

tol <- 1e-6
max_iter <- 100
converged <- FALSE

EYA <- YA
EYB <- YB
```




```{r}
# === 3. EM Algorithm ===
for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
  idx_A_missing <- is.na(YA) & !is.na(YB)
  idx_B_missing <- !is.na(YA) & is.na(YB)

  EYA[idx_A_missing] <- muA + rho * sqrt(sigmaA2) / sqrt(sigmaB2) * (YB[idx_A_missing] - muB)
  EYB[idx_B_missing] <- muB + rho * sqrt(sigmaB2) / sqrt(sigmaA2) * (YA[idx_B_missing] - muA)

  muA_new <- mean(EYA)
  muB_new <- mean(EYB)
  sigmaA2_new <- mean(EYA^2) - muA_new^2
  sigmaB2_new <- mean(EYB^2) - muB_new^2
  covAB <- mean(EYA * EYB) - muA_new * muB_new
  rho_new <- covAB / sqrt(sigmaA2_new * sigmaB2_new)

  diffs <- c(abs(muA_new - muA), abs(muB_new - muB),
             abs(sigmaA2_new - sigmaA2), abs(sigmaB2_new - sigmaB2),
             abs(rho_new - rho))
  if (max(diffs) < tol) {
    converged <- TRUE
    break
  }

  muA <- muA_new; muB <- muB_new
  sigmaA2 <- sigmaA2_new; sigmaB2 <- sigmaB2_new; rho <- rho_new
}

cat("Converged in", iter, "iterations\n")
cat(sprintf("muA = %.3f, muB = %.3f\n", muA, muB))
cat(sprintf("varA = %.3f, varB = %.3f, rho = %.3f\n", sigmaA2, sigmaB2, rho))
```

```{r}
# === 4. Paired T-Tests ===

complete_idx <- complete.cases(YA, YB)
pre_ttest <- t.test(YA[complete_idx], YB[complete_idx], paired = TRUE)
print(pre_ttest)


post_ttest <- t.test(EYA, EYB, paired = TRUE)
print(post_ttest)
```





```{r}
# === 5. Plot Distributions ===
df_long <- data.frame(
  value = c(YA, EYA, YB, EYB),
  stimulus = rep(c("A", "A", "B", "B"), each = N),
  type = c(rep("Observed", N), rep("Imputed", N), rep("Observed", N), rep("Imputed", N))
)

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = value, color = type, linetype = type)) +
  geom_density(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~stimulus, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Reaction Time Distributions (Stimulus A vs B)",
       x = "Reaction Time (ms)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# === 6. Export Imputed Dataset ===
completed_data <- data.frame(StimulusA = EYA, StimulusB = EYB)
write.csv(completed_data, "new_dataset.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
